### The Power of God's Word
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/power-gods-word
Passage: Jeremiah 23:29
Points:
- Scripture repeatedly emphasizes the active authority and sovereign effectiveness of God's Word.
- Jeremiah confronted false prophets who offered empty comfort while ignoring calls to genuine repentance.
- False teachers selectively preached comforting promises while omitting difficult truths about divine judgment.
- God's Word operates like fire and a hammer, breaking through self-reliance and convicting stubborn hearts.
- The same Word that shatters sin also refines believers and builds them up in godliness.
